disposition_reason: Original flame AAS measurements of Pb, Cd, Ni, Cu, Zn and Fe in 88 individual artisanal cheese samples from Tabasco and Chiapas, Mexico.

study.design: Survey of artisanal cheeses bought in producing municipalities
study.origin: Artisanal cheeses made in Tabasco (Huimanguillo, Balancan, Tenosique, Centro) and Chiapas (Solosuchiapa, Juarez, Catazaja, Reforma), Mexico
study.market: Acquired in the same municipalities (purchase outlet not stated)
study.method: Flame AAS (air-acetylene) after dry ashing at 450-500 °C and HNO3/H2O2 dissolution
study.qa: No CRM, recovery or blank results reported
